title: Japanese Kissed Soba Noodle Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired soba noodle bowl with a kissed sesame dressing.
instructions: Cook soba noodles according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together kissed sesame oil, oregano, and sesame seeds.
In a separate pan, toast the sesame seeds over low heat for 2-3 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked soba noodles, green onions, and sesame oil dressing.
Toss to coat the noodles evenly with the dressing.
Transfer the noodles to individual bowls and garnish with toasted sesame oil.
